title: Review Config
description: VERIFY-stage producer artifact. Output of review-configurator. Declares which lenses review the evidence, the independence anchors for each reviewer, and the synthesis mandate. Emitted only after check_review_independence.py finds no duplicate lenses or empty anchors.

run_ref.description: reference to the run being reviewed

lenses.description: ordered list of review lenses; each must be unique

lens.description: which reviewer perspective this entry governs. 'adversarial' is the eval-leakage / unfair-baseline lens (the #1 venue reject driver) used by the venue-review panel; the M2 freeze-check panel uses only methodology/domain.

anchor.description: non-empty independence anchor: the unique factual focus this lens owns (prevents duplicate/empty anchors)

reviewer_agent.description: agent name responsible for this lens

synthesis_mandate.description: instructions to the review-synthesizer: what must be covered, what constitutes an addressable vs fatal gap

inputs_to_review.description: artifact refs the panel must read (result_summary, experiment_matrix, protocol_spec, etc.)
